effects: Takes each amount in _amounts of stETH from the signer to the WithdrawalQueue, spending the signer's existing stETH allowance to the queue.
Mints one unstETH withdrawal NFT per amount to _owner, or to the signer when _owner is zero; the NFT owner alone can claim the ETH later.
No ETH arrives in this call; ETH comes later through a separate claim after finalization.
formats.shown: Intent 'Request Withdrawal', sentence 'Withdraw <amount> stETH', fields Amount (stETH) and Beneficiary (zero shown as Sender).

findings.title: requestWithdrawals interpolatedIntent says 'Withdraw' but the call only queues a request; ETH comes later.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Withdraw {_amounts.[]}"; WithdrawalQueue._requestWithdrawal: STETH.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amountOfStETH); ... requestId = _enqueue(...); _emitTransfer(address(0), _owner, requestId); no ETH is sent. Case 0 reader: 'Nothing immediately ... doesn't state it.'
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Request withdrawal of {_amounts.[]} for {_owner}".

findings.title: requestWithdrawals sentence omits the beneficiary who receives the withdrawal NFT and the ETH claim.
findings.evidence: descriptor: interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {_amounts.[]}" while field '#._owner' 'Beneficiary' exists; WithdrawalQueue.requestWithdrawals: requestIds[i] = _requestWithdrawal(_amounts[i], _owner). Case 0: unstETH NFT 118121 minted to the owner.
findings.fix: Add {_owner} to interpolatedIntent, e.g. "Request withdrawal of {_amounts.[]} for {_owner}".

findings.title: requestWithdrawals does not say the request is a transferable unstETH NFT.

findings.fix: Rename the Beneficiary label to 'unstETH NFT owner' or 'Request owner'.

cases.notes: stETH allowance consumed (approval to 0) is not shown; stETH out 0.0011 shown right; NFT to signer shown as Beneficiary conan26.eth, reader unsure it is themselves and did not know it is an NFT.

formats.key: requestWithdrawalsWithPermit(uint256[] _amounts, address _owner, (uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) _permit)
effects: Runs stETH.permit to set the signer's stETH allowance to the WithdrawalQueue to _permit.value.
Takes each amount of stETH from the signer to the queue, spending that allowance; any excess allowance stays with the queue.
Mints one unstETH withdrawal NFT per amount to _owner, or to the signer when _owner is zero.
formats.shown: Intent 'Request Withdrawal', sentence 'Withdraw <amount> stETH', fields Amount (stETH) and Beneficiary; all permit values hidden.

findings.title: requestWithdrawalsWithPermit hides the permit value, the stETH allowance the call sets for the queue.
findings.evidence: WithdrawalQueue.requestWithdrawalsWithPermit: STETH.permit(msg.sender, address(this), _permit.value, _permit.deadline, ...); descriptor: {"label": "Permit Value", "path": "#._permit.value", "visible": "never"}. Case 1: approval 1.3 stETH grant to the queue, not on the screen.
findings.fix: Show '#._permit.value' as tokenAmount with token $.metadata.constants.stETHaddress, label 'stETH allowance to queue'. Keep it out of interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: requestWithdrawalsWithPermit sentence says 'Withdraw' but the call only queues a request.

findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Request withdrawal of {_amounts.[]} for {_owner}".

findings.title: requestWithdrawalsWithPermit sentence omits the beneficiary who owns the withdrawal request.
